pr_title: Implement ADR 0154 target-aware animation motion binding
pr_body:
Implements the first-release ADR 0154 motion-binding architecture on current main. This first dispatcher request establishes the shared GUI-free planner, target-independent Humanoid identity, and persisted VMD Humanoid provenance contract. Follow-up dispatcher requests on the same Draft PR complete schema v3, runtime/Editor/build integration, tests, and visual validation.

The PR remains Draft and must not be merged automatically.
